name: Vlax Romani

ancestors.notes: Indo-Aryan language brought to Europe by Roma migrants from northern India, ultimately descended from Sanskrit/Prakrit.

The existing rom.json spec is glottolog-coded vlax1238 (Vlax Romani) and uses the same Romani Writing Standard alphabet; rmy is the specific ISO 639-3 code for Vlax Romani (the macrolanguage code 'rom' spans all Romani varieties). Grapheme table inherited unchanged (graphemes_base=rom).

Wikipedia (Vlax Romani): 'The Vlax Roma...originate from the former Roma slaves in the principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (with the name "Vlax", which comes from "Vlach", coming from the latter), now Romania.' Matras (2002) documents Romanian as a major lexical-donor language for Vlax Romani dialects generally, consistent with this multi-century Romanian-principality residence.

notes: Vlax Romani, the largest Romani dialect subgroup after Balkan Romani (Northern Vlax: Kalderash, Lovari; Southern Vlax). Named for the Romanian-speaking principalities (Wallachia/Moldavia = 'Vlach' lands) where its speakers were historically enslaved, hence the strong Romanian adstrate. Orthography and phonology (aspirated stops čh/kh/ph/th, etc.) match the existing rom.json spec, which is itself glottolog-coded vlax1238; graphemes are inherited from it rather than duplicated.
